description: Sharpbeak is held in a cage, high on a cliff at the top of Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands.  The key to this cage is possessed by the high priestess of the Vilebranch trolls, Vile Priestess Hexx.
There.  I have done my part.  I bid you fortune on your quest, <name>.
completion: You've spoken with Grimshade?  What did he say?
...What?  The Vilebranch trolls have Sharpbeak?  That's unbearable!  We must organize a force to get him back!
